description: Detection Finding (2004) surfacing over the tenzir OCSF archive (s3://tenzir/ocsf/, class_uid=2004 partitions) through the tenzir-ocsf DuckDB datasource view. Findings come from two sources: sigma matches on the core node's OCSF bus (stamped rule_id + subject) and trivy ExposedSecretReport findings (same stamp via the trivy pipeline). Grafana owns alerting off this archive; there is no other findings egress. Panels are empty until the archive parquet flows.

panels.description: Detection Finding (2004) rate per bucket split by severity_id caption. Sources: sigma matches (k8s-audit derived) and trivy ExposedSecretReport findings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  CASE severity_id
    WHEN 0 THEN '0 Unknown'
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low'
    WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium'
    WHEN 4 THEN '4 High'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical'
    ELSE '99 Other'
  END AS severity,
  count(*) AS findings
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Detection findings by severity over time

panels.description: severity_id captions for Detection Findings in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE severity_id
    WHEN 0 THEN '0 Unknown'
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low'
    WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium'
    WHEN 4 THEN '4 High'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical'
    ELSE '99 Other'
  END AS severity,
  count(*) AS findings
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Severity distribution

panels.description: Detection Findings per rule (finding_info.title) in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(finding_info.title, finding_info.uid) AS rule,
       count(*) AS hits
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top rules

panels.description: Detecting engine per finding: metadata.product.name (sigma findings report the engine; trivy findings report trivy).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(metadata.product.name, 'unknown') AS source,
       count(*) AS findings
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Findings by source

panels.description: Per-rule Detection Finding rate per bucket (finding_info.title).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  coalesce(finding_info.title, finding_info.uid) AS rule,
  count(*) AS findings
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Findings rate by rule

panels.description: Objects the findings point at: the stable stamp fields subject_kind/subject_namespace/subject_name (rule id + subject composite).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT subject_kind AS kind,
       subject_namespace AS namespace,
       subject_name AS name,
       count(*) AS hits
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Affected subjects

panels.description: Detection Findings (2004) in the window: severity/status captions, rule, source, and the stamp subject fields (subject_kind/subject_namespace/subject_name).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       CASE severity_id WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical' WHEN 4 THEN '4 High' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium' WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low' WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational' ELSE '0 Unknown' END AS severity,
       CASE status_id WHEN 1 THEN '1 Success' WHEN 2 THEN '2 Failure' WHEN 99 THEN '99 Other' ELSE '0 Unknown' END AS status,
       finding_info.title AS finding,
       coalesce(metadata.product.name, 'unknown') AS source,
       rule_id,
       subject_kind AS subject_kind,
       subject_namespace AS subject_namespace,
       subject_name AS subject_name
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Detection findings

panels.description: The OCSF source event behind each sigma Detection Finding (first evidence): acting user, api.operation, and the k8s object_ref the rule matched on. trivy findings carry no evidence. Resolves once the first sigma finding archives; until then the column set does not exist in the 2004 partitions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       finding_info.title AS finding,
       evidences[1].data.actor.user.name AS evidence_user,
       evidences[1].data.api.operation AS evidence_operation,
       evidences[1].data.unmapped.object_ref.resource AS evidence_resource,
       evidences[1].data.unmapped.object_ref.namespace AS evidence_namespace,
       evidences[1].data.unmapped.object_ref.name AS evidence_object
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2004
  AND evidences IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 50
